name: gpt cli
description: gpt-cli - 简洁高效的 OpenAI ChatGPT 命令行客户端

post_install.description: 检查 OPEN_AI_KEY 环境变量
post_install.command: if [ -z "$OPEN_AI_KEY" ]; then echo '\n========================================' && echo '警告: OPEN_AI_KEY 环境变量未设置!' && echo '========================================' && echo '' && echo '请先设置 OpenAI API Key:' && echo '  export OPEN_AI_KEY="your-api-key"' && echo '' && echo '建议添加到 ~/.zshrc 或 ~/.bashrc:' && echo '  echo "export OPEN_AI_KEY=\"your-api-key\"" >> ~/.zshrc' && echo '  source ~/.zshrc' && echo '' && echo '获取 API Key: https://platform.openai.com/api-keys' && echo '========================================\n'; else echo 'OPEN_AI_KEY 已设置'; fi

post_uninstall: echo '提示: OPEN_AI_KEY 环境变量仍保留在 shell 配置文件中'

commands.check_key: echo $OPEN_AI_KEY | head -c 10 && echo '...' || echo 'OPEN_AI_KEY 未设置'

status_check.name: 检查 OPEN_AI_KEY
status_check.command: if [ -n "$OPEN_AI_KEY" ]; then echo 'OPEN_AI_KEY 已设置'; else echo 'OPEN_AI_KEY 未设置 - 请运行: export OPEN_AI_KEY="your-key"'; fi

notes: 需要设置 OPEN_AI_KEY 环境变量。获取 API Key: https://platform.openai.com/api-keys
